parameters.name: ListenerPort
parameters.description: The frontend port that is used by the Edge Load Balance (ELB) instance. Valid values: **1** to **65535**.

parameters.name: ListenerProtocol
parameters.description:
The frontend protocol that is used by the ELB instance.

>  This parameter is required if the same port is used by listeners that use different protocols.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerId
parameters.description: The ID of the ELB instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens delete-load-balancer-listener --listener-port 8080 --load-balancer-id lb-5snthcyu1x10g7tywj7iu0000 --listener-protocol tcp --region cn-hangzhou
